name: Alyssa R. Mancy
source: As a stylist and aspiring fashionista, you'd think Alyssa would have no problem with confidence... but who can stay that way in front of a guy who frankly makes the date suck? It's her first blind date and if it doesn't go well, her friend claims she'll be alone for the rest of her life. But that can't be true - or can it? She'll just have to do her best or else!
